label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
Sneha, no no, fair question da. Rohan and Divya trusted me with 3 lakh, he’s allowed to ask where it is without booking an appointment with my LinkedIn personality.

Straight answer: your money is at risk. It’s not gone, but I can’t honestly tell you it’s safe either. We still have a business and a plan I believe in. Whether we can make it work before the cash runs out is the actual question.

What happened: the bridge round from the Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 Oct. Term sheet was basically ready, and then it didn’t happen. Important difference between “basically ready” and money in the bank, which I have now learnt in the most expensive way possible. The partner said “we love the energy” and then didn’t reply for 11 days. Apparently they loved it enough to leave it undisturbed.

Last Friday we let go of 6 out of 14 people. Everyone got two months’ pay, and we’ve helped four get interviews already. Interviews, not jobs yet. I’m still following up. It was genuinely the worst day of my life. These people did good work and had to deal with the consequences of us not having enough money. Not going to put a motivational quote on that.

After the cuts, we have about five months of runway.

The app has around 41k monthly users. Plumbing and electrical work is growing; AC servicing is bleeding money. So the plan is to shut AC servicing and focus on housing society tie-ups. We’ve signed pilots with three societies in HSR already. Those are pilots, not proof that everything is sorted, but they’re a concrete chance to see if this works.

I honestly think we have a real shot there. I also thought the bridge round would close, so please apply the appropriate discount to founder confidence.

On your and Divya’s investment specifically: the 3 lakh from the 2025 friends round is on the same terms as everyone else’s. I can’t promise you’ll get it back. I also don’t want you thinking the company has shut and nobody told you. Neither “all fine bro” nor “write it off tonight” would be a straight answer.

Let’s get on a proper call this week, all three of us. I’ll show you the numbers, what we’re spending, and what needs to happen in these five months. Divya shouldn’t have to rely on you decoding my cricket-captain posts over dinner. You both deserve better than that.

Personally, I’m okay. Have eaten enough 11pm office Maggi that security uncle now asks “masala or plain?” like I have a corporate meal plan. Amma has also asked whether TCS is still hiring, so the board is exploring alternatives.

And yes, coming Saturday. You can ask me questions in person also. Pranav is buying. That funding round I would like closed before we order.
